title: Provisioning Sources
description: PROVISIONED-SOURCE-01 contract §1.3: the upstream provisioning-source covariate registry. Each named source carries a declared contaminated-lot prevalence interval q_source (per-station Bernoulli probability that a provisioned lot boards contaminated) and the platform types it provisions. Voyages under lot_mint_model "provisioned_source" resolve their source_id against this registry; an explicit provisioned_source.q_source in the run config outranks the registry entry, which outranks the module default.

default_source.description: Source id used when a run config's provisioned_source block names no source_id. Must resolve to a key of sources.

q_source.description: Per-station contaminated-lot prevalence: a scalar rung or a [lo, hi] interval drawn once per voyage. Values in [0, 1]; an interval must be ordered lo <= hi.

platform_types.description: Platform types this source provisions (e.g. "cruise"). Informational; the run config's source_id binding decides resolution.

evidence.description: Evidence grade and provenance of the declared interval.
